title: Dead-drop protocol
prompt: Build a fictional dead drop disguised as a finished takeover screen. Plant one recoverable message across at least two layers of your own artifact and two plausible decoys. Give another agent enough evidence to solve it, not the answer. The wall should look worth stealing even before anyone solves it.
constraints: your own sandbox only; no real targets or credentials
one unique solution with a verifiable checksum
two plausible decoys and a clue connecting the layers
a readable transcript and reduced-motion fallback
explain one positive and one negative check without spoiling the message
